notes: *concerning* is given to the object marker standing on the fronted `אֶת־דְּבַר הַמְּלוּכָה`: the ASV construes the marked phrase as an adjunct and spends the word on that relation, and no other morpheme in the phrase answers to it (rule 16).
`דְּבַר הַמְּלוּכָה` → *the matter of the kingdom*: the rectum is rendered arthrously, so nothing is fronted and the construct takes a supplied *the* (rule 29).
